description: Turn Antigravity CLI into a native BB provider with persistent instructions, tip forking, /compact, and a live /swarm board. Go beyond bare ACP chat with low-through-max reasoning, readable command cards with sandbox-escape prompts, live background task banners, and one worker process per thread. Track 5-hour and 7-day per-model quota windows in BB, verify sign-in and CLI updates without spending tokens, and browse antigravity-prefixed builtin skills. Requires Antigravity CLI 1.5.0+ (1.5.14+ for /compact) and a signed-in Google account on the host; verified on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
